description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2019 World Championships with Reshiram & Charizard-GX. Jirachi digs for Trainer cards and slips away on an Escape Board even when Asleep, Welder and Giant Hearth keep Fire Energy flowing for a huge Double Blaze-GX, and Ninetales discards that Energy to drag a Benched Pokémon into battle. The 2019 World Championships were held at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., in August 2019.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2019 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box, a pin and a code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
